changelog.summary: Initial release against the official Claude Certified Associate – Foundations Exam Guide v1.0 (effective July 2026): 7 domains with the official weights, 30 lessons (one per exam objective, titles verbatim) with a claim, diagram, Real use, How it works, Choose when, How to do it, Exam Trap and verified Claude Help Center, privacy, Usage Policy and AI Fluency links; Deep Dive and Cheat Sheet per domain. 90 questions (3 per lesson, correct answers balanced across A–D) and 2 case studies.

Rebuilt by the agent team against Exam Guide v1.0. Notes: all 30 lessons rewritten in the lessons format with one-line claims (20 words or fewer), failure-first How it works, real Choose when rows, single-idea traps, distinct real-use settings and verified Help Center and Academy links; new teaching on technical prompts, curation, code execution and Skills, managing uploads, the regulatory frame and the 3.2/3.3 split, and corrected facts (Opus is the most capable of the three named families, effort is the main lever, memory by plan, Ultra, incognito retention). Deep Dives follow the AI Fluency 4Ds; only GCAFE and ZONE remain as acronyms. Diagrams: 8 kept, 5 revised and 17 replaced. Questions: 90 fixed (length giveaway removed, plausible distractors, recall items rewritten, near-copies of the official samples replaced) and 91 added, 181 in all, single-answer, ordered easy to hard with 22% hard. Case studies: 001 rebuilt, 002 extended, 3 new; all 30 tasks reached.

title: Claude Certified Associate – Foundations
description: For professionals who use Claude every day in operations, marketing, project management, education and communications. Covers prompting, checking outputs, choosing features and models, setting up Projects and connectors, responsible use and troubleshooting. No coding required.
